name_zh: 穆希卡/乌拉圭/贫民/总统/大麻/合法/瓜亚基/何塞/最穷总统
description_zh: 何塞·穆希卡 (1955-) 乌拉圭总统 (2010-2015) 出身贫民，执政期间推动大麻合法化，倡导绿色政治和生活简约，捐赠92%的工资，推行社会改革，被誉为'世界上最穷的总统'，代表了另类政治和全民福祉。
description_en: Jose Mucaji (1955-) Uruguayan President (2010-2015) from poor background, promoted marijuana legalization, advocated green politics and simple living, donated 92% of salary, implemented social reforms, known as 'the world's poorest president', represents alternative politics and popular welfare.
reason_zh: 穆希卡代表了另类政治领导模式，如何从底层崛起，通过极简生活和全民福祉推动社会变革，以及大麻合法化等全球政策的创新。
reason_en: Mucaji represents alternative political leadership model, from grassroots rise, through minimalist life and popular welfare to promote social change, and innovative policies like marijuana legalization globally.
